Budget a full wrap rough project estimate — not a firm quote

Wraps are priced per project once we see the vehicle and design, but here's a ballpark before you upload or pick anything: printed wrap material comes off the roll in panels roughly 60″ wide × 144″ long (5×12 ft, 60 ft² each). Most sedans and coupes take about 2 panels (~120 ft²); larger SUVs and trucks run closer to 3 panels (~180 ft²) once you count trim waste and overlap. This includes a rough design fee and install labor along with material and lamination — real coverage and final cost always depend on your specific vehicle and design.

FAQ Wraps & Prints

How long does a full wrap take?
Most full wraps take 3–5 business days once the design is approved; partial wraps and smaller print jobs are usually faster.
How long does a wrap last?
Typically 5–7 years with reasonable care, depending on the film, color and sun exposure — it's removable, unlike paint.
Should I remove an old wrap myself?
We recommend having it removed professionally to protect the paint underneath — we offer wrap removal as part of a re-wrap.
Do you install wraps you didn't print?
Contact us — we can often quote installation on print-ready files from another shop, reviewed case by case.

FAQ Vinyl Lettering

What sizes can you cut?
0.25″ to 24″ tall, up to 50 ft wide — contact us for anything wider.
Is this vinyl outdoor-rated?
Yes — outdoor-durable, rated for several years depending on color and exposure.
Can I get a color that's not in stock?
Yes — unlock special-order colors at checkout. Adds a few business days.
Do you install it for me?
This is self-install (instructions included). Contact us for professional installation.

FAQ Number Plates

What are number plates made from?
Layered cut vinyl, same material as Lettering — background, linework, number and flag are separate colors stacked and weeded by hand, not printed.
Do all plates in a set match?
Yes — every plate in the set uses the exact same design, size, colors and number.
Can I use my own custom colors?
Yes — swap any of the Background, Number or Line colors to another in-stock (or special-order) Avery Dennison color.
Can plates be laminated for extra durability?
We can add a clear laminate layer on request — mention it in your notes when you save/email your quote.

FAQ Decal Kits

Can I upload my own design?
Not for Decal Kits — every design here is one the shop created and stands behind. For custom text, use Lettering; for anything else custom, send us a quote request.
What colors is the ICARUS logo available in?
Any in-stock Avery Dennison cut-vinyl color — gold and black are both in stock now, with special-order colors available too.
How is this different from Lettering?
Lettering cuts your own custom text; Decal Kits are ready-made shop designs, sized to fit whatever you're putting them on.
Is it outdoor rated?
Yes — same outdoor-durable cut vinyl used for Lettering and Number Plates.

About ICARUS ink — Vehicle Wraps & Vinyl Graphics in McKinney, TX

ICARUS ink is a motorsports-inspired vinyl and vehicle wrap shop based in McKinney, Texas. We design, print, cut and install custom vehicle wraps, color changes, vinyl lettering, decal kits and racing number plates for daily drivers, race cars, small businesses and fleets across the Dallas–Fort Worth area. Every job is handled in-house from first sketch to final install, using real Avery Dennison cut-vinyl and print film — nothing is outsourced.

Looking for a vinyl wrap shop near McKinney TX?
